subtitles.en: We've got a screamer of a headline on the terminal from the Wall Street Journal that NVIDIA is in fact now preparing to oust Jensen Wong as the CEO of the company that he
subtitles.zh: 我们终端上有一条来自《华尔街日报》的劲爆头条，称英伟达实际上正准备罢免黄仁勋的首席执行官职务，而他于1993年创立了该公司。

subtitles.en: founded in 1993. Yeah, the journal reporting that the board is preparing to meet as soon as today, Wednesday,
subtitles.zh: 是的，《华尔街日报》报道称，董事会准备最早于今日周三开会，

subtitles.en: to determine his future. All of this, according to people familiar with the matter, but, of course, this headline follows just shortly ago the New York Times reporting on a second extra marital affair
subtitles.zh: 以决定他的未来。据知情人士透露，这一切发生之前不久，《纽约时报》刚刚报道了第二段婚外情，

subtitles.en: with an NVIDIA employee, someone who reported to Jensen Wong, a vice president of health care.
subtitles.zh: 涉及一名英伟达员工，该员工曾向黄仁勋汇报，是一位医疗保健副总裁。

subtitles.en: So now it's allegations of two extra marital affairs, of course, the first that was reported, and that he admitted to just days ago with a woman who is alleged to be a Chinese spy.
subtitles.zh: 因此，现在有两段婚外情的指控，当然，第一段是几天前报道的，他本人也承认了，对方被指是一名中国间谍。
en_highlights: allegations of two extra marital affairs

subtitles.en: Again, the Wall Street Journal is reporting that NVIDIA is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Wong as soon as today, and we are seeing the losses building for this stock after hours
subtitles.zh: 再次强调，《华尔街日报》报道称，英伟达准备最早于今日罢免首席执行官黄仁勋，我们看到该股在盘后交易中跌幅扩大，

subtitles.en: falling as much as 8%. We're down in 158 dollars to share here.
subtitles.zh: 跌幅高达8%。股价已跌至每股158美元。

subtitles.en: This is a stock that closed at 173, investors are not waiting around to find out more.
subtitles.zh: 该股收盘价为173美元，市场参与者没有等待更多消息。

subtitles.en: And we should include the fact that Jensen Wong has not admitted to this second affair and has suggested that there was nothing untoward involving spying or delivering information to
subtitles.zh: 我们还应该提到，黄仁勋尚未承认第二段婚外情，并表示在已知的两段关系中的第一段里，没有涉及间谍活动或向中方传递信息的不当行为。

subtitles.en: the Chinese in the first of the two relationships that we know about.
subtitles.zh: 即我们所知的两段关系中的第一段。

subtitles.en: But this is getting tough here, obviously, from an HR perspective alone, he might not be able to remain CEO of this company.
subtitles.zh: 但从人事角度看，情况变得棘手，他可能无法继续担任公司CEO。

大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现

把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
